nary_nodes.label: 'Brand New Day' Opening Weekend Haul
evidence: estimated haul of $355 million in the U.S. and Canada
brought in $572 million internationally for a worldwide total of $927 million
“Spider-Man: Brand New Day” swung into the top spot at the box office and scored one of the highest-grossing opening weekends with an estimated haul of $355 million in the U.S. and Canada
The Sony Pictures film also brought in $572 million internationally for a worldwide total of $927 million, according to studio estimates.

nary_nodes.label: 'Brand New Day' Global Ranking
evidence: ranks as the second-biggest domestic and global opening ever
The movie’s haul now ranks as the second-biggest domestic and global opening ever, surpassed only by Walt Disney Co. and Marvel Studios’ “Avengers: Endgame” in 2019.

nary_nodes.label: 'No Way Home' Domestic Debut
evidence: had one of the biggest domestic debuts on record with $260 million
The previous film in the franchise, 2021’s “Spider-Man: No Way Home,” had one of the biggest domestic debuts on record with $260 million.
